disclosure: FIXTURE DATA — simulated API and model responses produced by `notary demo --fixture`; not a live run

SIMULATED MID-RUN API CHANGE (fixture scenario change-api): right after queue item q09 is decided in each queue run, POST /refunds now reads a partial refund's items[].amount in MINOR units (the documented unit): PLANTED QUIRK Q4 stops for every partial refund from this moment on. In this scenario GET /payments enforces the documented page_size max (PLANTED QUIRK Q1 on GET /refunds only), so refunds can pass the gate.

PLANTED FIXTURE QUIRKS (simulated, not claims about the real APIs): Q1 GET /refunds: page_size > 100 (documented max) is accepted and silently clamped to 100 (GET /payments enforces the documented max in this scenario); Q2 POST /customers/{id}/wallets/ledger-entries: `amount` is read in MAJOR units: crediting 1000 adds 100000 minor units; INTERMITTENT: amounts from 3000 to 3999 are read correctly (minor units); Q3 POST /customers/{id}/wallets/ledger-entries: `idempotency_key` is ignored: each repeat of a keyed credit creates a new entry; Q4 POST /refunds (partial): `items[].amount` is read in MAJOR units and silently capped at the line price: every partial refund refunds the whole item; Q5 POST /refunds (full): no duplicate protection (a retried full refund creates a second refund), and full refunds answer slowly; Q6 POST /company/enrich: notion.so funding.total_investment_usd comes back as the string "$343M"
Reflector and adversary are deterministic model doubles (fixture model, no cost); token counts are estimates, usd 0.
Probe caps raised for the fixture demo only: 6 per claim, 40 per run (live defaults 5 and 30).

Notarize run: anomalies from the deterministic checker, rival hypotheses proposed by the reflector model, probes with predictions committed before each call, verdicts by deterministic rules. Beliefs are Beta(α, β) over the doc claim holding (only confirmed probes update), every cited span is checked against runs/<runId>/spans.jsonl, and candidates are reviewed by the adversary.
Dodo Payments test mode only; refund and change-plan probes use seeded probe-only payments and subscriptions the seeded queue does not reference.

Verification probes: 6 required claim(s) with no anomaly this run (dodo.payment.refunds-lists-issued-refund, dodo.payments.page-size-max-100, dodo.refund.amount-minor-units, dodo.refund.full-retry-no-duplicate, dodo.refunds.amount-integer, dodo.subscription.change-plan-pending-409) were probed against a deterministic rival pair {honored, suspected class from src/contracts/priors-map.ts} built by code, not proposed by a model; same commit-then-run loop, caps and budget.
belief_precision is measured against the deterministic checker on the SAME recording (not an independent ground truth); see docs/AUDIT.md A-14
